subject: MSA + Order Form: assigning internal reviewers and exhibit list
body:
From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@stratus.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@stratus.ai
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 10:14:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MSA + Order Form for review (attachments)

Hi Diego,

Thanks for taking this on. Attached are the draft MSA and the Q3 order form for our pilot. High level: we expect low-volume inference to start in October (pilot) then scale in December if tests look good. Please confirm who on your side should receive the initial redlines and who will own the signature path.

Attachments included: Stratus_MSA_v1.pdf, OrderForm_Stratus_Q3.xlsx, preliminary SignatoryMatrix_Stratus.csv

A few items we'd like clarity on before redlining:
- Billing contact and invoice cadence (monthly vs. quarterly).
- Data residency for logs (we will need EU-only option if any EU traffic).
- Exhibit A: expected per-token pricing bands — we left placeholders.

Can you loop in the appropriate contracts contact and SOC2/security person so we can exchange evidence? Target: receive redlines by 09/23 so we can finalize pilot SOW the following week.

Best,
Lisa Chen
VP, Partnerships 
Stratus AI

---

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@stratus.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MSA + Order Form for review (attachments)

Thanks Lisa — received and downloading now.

Quick answers and asks from our side:
- Billing: we can support monthly invoicing for the pilot; finance prefers net-30.
- Data residency: can you confirm expected traffic split by region? If EU traffic >0.1% we'll need the EU residency addendum.
- Pricing: we'll propose Exhibit A ranges after a quick run of the expected QPS and retention assumptions; can you add a row in the order form with projected avg tokens/day?

Kimberly / Marissa — can you take primary review on legal redlines and signatory routing? Kimberly, please confirm who should be the primary signatory on Redwood's side and whether we should route to centralized legal or the Head of Product for the pilot.

I'll assemble a short party sheet and a tentative timeline.

Diego Fernandez
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

---

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MSA + Order Form for review (attachments)

Diego — putting Legal on point.

Plan:
1) Marissa will do a first-pass commercial redline (pricing, billing cadence, Exhibit A placeholders).
2) I will do a legal pass focusing on liability, data residency carveouts, IP, and indemnities.
3) Jonas will assess signature routing and counterparty signatory authority if needed.

Requests for Stratus:
- Please fill the SignatoryMatrix_Stratus.csv with signatory names, titles, and email addresses (we need name+title for DocuSign).
- Please indicate anticipated monthly token volumes (approx).
- Security evidence: a link to your SOC 2 report or a pointer to where we should request details.

Tentative internal SLA: initial redlines back to Stratus by 2025-09-23 EOD PDT. If the order form contains usage SLAs requiring engineering review, that may add 48 hours.

Marissa / Jonas — flag anything that looks like a non-standard revenue commitment or resale clause.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference

---

From: Lisa Chen <lisa.chen@stratus.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft MSA + Order Form for review (attachments)

Thanks — quick follow-ups and I attached an updated signatory matrix.

Answers inline:
- SignatoryMatrix_Stratus.csv: completed and attached. Primary signatory: Lisa Chen (CEO), backup: Raj Patel (CFO).
- Monthly tokens: pilot ~150k tokens/month, production estimate ~3.2M tokens/month if we get to full launch in December. We added a column in the order form with projected AvgTokensPerDay.
- SOC2: here's the link to our files: https://secure.stratus.ai/soc2/2025-report (contractor access enabled).

We can accept net-30. We prefer Redwood to be able to provide EU residency for any EU-sourced traffic. Let us know what form of residency language you prefer and whether an addendum is sufficient.

Next steps suggested by Stratus: please send redlines to contracts@stratus.ai and include a short summary of major clause changes so our legal team can triage quickly. If you can confirm a final DocuSign routing path we can prep envelopes on our side (CEO first, then CFO).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking to lock pilot terms this month.

Best,
Lisa Chen
VP, Partnerships
Stratus AI

Attachments referenced in-thread: Stratus_MSA_v1.pdf; OrderForm_Stratus_Q3.xlsx; SignatoryMatrix_Stratus.csv

---

Internal notes (not sent):
- Diego to upload party sheet to Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleLink
- Legal to prepare redline summary template for contracts@stratus.ai to speed triage.
- Action: Marissa to draft Exhibit A pricing bands and propose startup pilot discount; Kimberly to draft EU residency addendum language.
